sources.title: EU Plants — YANA original USPP34772P3 patent
sources.enumerated_scope: Complete ten-page original grant: cover, description, single cultivar claim and all seven drawing plates. Enumeration limited to the granted YANA cultivar; comparisons and references are excluded.
sources.limitations: Printed EU PLANTS LTD applicant and assignee wording connects the source to the existing company for review only. No approved breeder/owner/licensee role or current legal status. Original observations and photos do not approve traits, growing regions or reuse.

names.portfolio_context: Original USPP34772P3 publication dated 2022-11-29 names YANA and contains one cultivar claim. Application 17/164,322 filed 2021-02-01; foreign priority PBR 2020/0331 dated 2020-01-30 is an application reference, not proof of a current CPVO grant. Printed applicant EU PLANTS LTD and assignee EU PLANTS LTD OF MANOR FARM are historical document fields; current ownership and company roles require separate review. Reported plant/fruit observations and comparisons remain source assertions under their stated conditions, without an approved trait or growing footprint.
